meta.name: commission-calculator
meta.description: Calculate realistic affiliate earnings projections before committing to a program. Use this skill when the user asks about affiliate earnings, projecting income, calculating commissions, estimating how much they can make, comparing program payouts, or says "how much can I make promoting X", "calculate my affiliate income", "is this commission worth it", "how long to first $1000", "compare earnings between programs", "traffic to income calculator", "what conversion rate should I expect", "earnings estimate for affiliate program", "how many sales do I need".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预估联盟营销收益，对比项目佣金
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在评估联盟营销项目的潜在收入
copy.tagline_en: Estimate affiliate earnings and compare program payouts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you evaluate potential income from affiliate marketing programs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会根据你提供的流量、平台和佣金结构，计算预计每月收入，并对比不同联盟计划的盈利潜力。它还可以反向计算达成收入目标所需的访问量或销售额。
howto.when: 当你询问联盟营销收入预估、比较计划佣金、或说出“推广X能赚多少”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我有个每月5000访客的博客，推广HeyGen能赚多少？
对比ConvertKit和Mailchimp的联盟收入，我有2000邮件订阅者。
我想每月赚1000美元，需要多少访问量？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude calculates projected monthly earnings based on traffic, platform, and commission structures. It compares multiple programs and can reverse-calculate traffic needed for a goal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user asks about affiliate earnings, comparing programs, or says "how much can I make promoting X" and similar phrases.

say_en.text: I have a blog with 5,000 monthly visitors, how much can I make promoting HeyGen?
Compare ConvertKit vs Mailchimp affiliate income, I have 2,000 email subscribers.
I want to earn $1,000/month, how many visitors do I need?
